factor_name: Adaptive Breadth-Conditioned Recovery Pullback Risk-Adjusted Momentum

calculation.description: Contrarian recovery-pullback signal: rewards assets whose medium-term move relative to recent momentum is favorable after downside-volatility adjustment, with a smooth cross-asset 20-day positive-return breadth conditioning multiplier. All inputs are lagged one completed day before use. Cross-sectional percentile rank is used for portfolio integration.

validation.regime_notes: 20-day IC/ICIR: 2026-2028 0.074962/0.221404 (477 observations); 2029-2030 0.188238/0.658262 (321); 2031 YTD 0.210752/0.499395 (116). Low coverage and 15-asset cross-section require conservative weighting.
